00688.indication: Adult unresectable locally advanced or metastatic TNBC, PD-L1 tumour-infiltrating immune-cell expression at least 1%, no prior chemotherapy/targeted systemic treatment for inoperable advanced TNBC. NCCP specifies Ventana SP142 immune-cell scoring; CPS is not interchangeable.

drugs.infusion: 60 minutes initially; 30 minutes later if tolerated

00688.duration: Nab-paclitaxel up to six cycles; extension is a consultant decision. Atezolizumab continues until progression or unacceptable toxicity and may continue after chemotherapy stops; confirm the active prescription.

support.premedication: None usually required; do not copy routine corticosteroid/antihistamine premedication from solvent-based paclitaxel
support.additional: Consider analgesic cover for myalgia/arthralgia. Immune alert information and urgent contacts remain essential, including after treatment ends.

baseline: Cardiac function if significant cardiac history or prior anthracycline
regular: FBC, renal, liver and glucose profile before each cycle
Frequent blood counts for nab-paclitaxel; Day 1 versus Day 8/15 thresholds differ, so confirm required pre-dose counts locally
Response imaging/review according to the consultant treatment plan

bodymap.text: Low counts: report fever, shivering, bleeding or sudden illness urgently.
Report tingling, numbness or loss of function; may need dose interruption or change.
New cough or breathlessness requires prompt assessment; immune inflammation is one possible cause.
New or worsening diarrhoea, abdominal pain or blood in stool needs prompt advice.
Blood tests assess liver injury; report yellow skin or eyes and dark urine.
New severe fatigue, dizziness, thirst or frequent urination may signal hormone or glucose disturbance.
Spreading rash, blistering or mouth sores need urgent assessment.

clinical_limits: No atezolizumab dose reductions; holds/stops are agent specific.
Do not infer routine three-monthly echo monitoring.
NCCP p3 inclusive Day 1 count threshold differs from strict restart prose p8: exact equality at restart is flagged for review.
Immune hepatitis and nab-paclitaxel hepatic impairment are different pathways; assess cause and AST separately from ALT.

00738.indication: NCCP: adult triple-negative or HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. EMA Avastin: first-line in combination with paclitaxel. Verify line and local approval; NCCP table N/A is not an automatic reimbursement assurance.

drugs.infusion: 90 minutes initially, then 60 minutes, then 30 minutes if tolerated; no IV push
One hour; non-PVC apparatus and 0.22 µm filter

00738.duration: Until progression or unacceptable toxicity. If one medicine is held or stopped, the clinician must confirm which medicines continue; no automatic maintenance switch is prescribed by this map.

support.premed_first_paclitaxel: Dexamethasone 8 mg IV, chlorphenamine 10 mg IV and famotidine 20 mg IV, 30 minutes before paclitaxel.
support.premed_from_day8: Source table omits routine dexamethasone; add only for increased risk or prior hypersensitivity under consultant guidance. Chlorphenamine 10 mg IV continues; famotidine 20 mg IV may be omitted in the absence of reactions under consultant guidance.
support.notes: Reconcile antiemetic steroid exposure with the premedication prescription. Bevacizumab-only administration does not require paclitaxel premedicines. Unlicensed rapid bevacizumab infusion requires separate local governance.

baseline: Consider ECHO if prior chest irradiation or anthracycline
regular: FBC including explicit Day 8 FBC, renal and liver profile; confirm required results before each dose
Urine protein dipstick; quantitative collection when indicated
BP before each bevacizumab dose (narrative p7); table also specifies before cycle and post-treatment
Warfarin INR weekly until stable, then before each cycle
Review neuropathy and response on the agreed treatment plan

surgery.before_major: Withhold for 28 days before major elective surgery, or consultant-directed plan
surgery.before_minor: Withhold for 7 days before minor surgery, or consultant-directed plan
surgery.after_major: Do not initiate for at least 28 days after major surgery AND until the wound is fully healed
surgery.complication: Withhold for wound-healing complications until fully healed; necrotising fasciitis requires discontinuation and urgent treatment

bodymap.text: Low counts: fever or sudden illness needs urgent advice.
Report numbness, tingling or trouble with daily activities.
Blood pressure and clot/bleeding risks require review; severe headache, chest pain or new weakness is urgent.
Urine tests monitor protein loss; report swelling or reduced urine.
Severe abdominal pain or bleeding needs urgent assessment.
Tell the team about operations, dental procedures and wounds that are not healing.

clinical_limits: No bevacizumab dose reduction; suspend or discontinue for relevant toxicity.
Paclitaxel haematological ladder 80→65→50 differs from hepatic 80/60/40 and toxicity-specific 10 mg/m² decrements.
Platelets 90 overlap and bilirubin decimal gaps require review.
Bevacizumab protein concentration in g/L and 24-hour total g/24h are not interchangeable.
